games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.author: CD PROJEKT RED
games.about: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

games.title: Palworld
games.author: Pocketpair

games.title: FOR HONOR
games.author: Ubisoft Montreal, Ubisoft Quebec, Ubisoft Toronto, Blue Byte
games.about: For Honor is a groundbreaking team-based PvP melee fighting game where Knights, Samurai, Vikings, Wu Lin, and more clash in endless battles. Pick unique heroes and master intense 4v4, 2v2, or 1v1 battles.
